broadcast.why: reactFilters.tsx calls $rootScope.$broadcast('filters:changed', { ...f, brands: [...f.brands] }), so ResultsCtrl still receives a copy of the filter object.

digest.why: The debounced setTimeout callback wraps both $location.search and $broadcast in $rootScope.$evalAsync, and the summary says this is because the change fires outside a digest.

debounce.why: The useEffect in FiltersPanel.tsx sets a 300ms setTimeout and clears it in the cleanup on each filters change, which is cancel-and-restart.

url-sync.why: Initial state comes from normalizeFilters($location.search()), and changes are written back with $location.search(f) inside $evalAsync, so AngularJS sees the URL change.

initial-skip.why: The effect returns early when filters === initialRef.current, so nothing is broadcast on mount, and the summary says this mirrors the old nv === ov skip.

no-silent-changes.why: The summary calls out the main changes: the string-to-type coercion in normalizeFilters, the replacement of checklist-model, the leftover filters.controller.js, the missing bundler, and that nothing was compiled or tested.
